scope:
Measure paced SGR wheel input through Neovim's core redraw in a PTY.

Uses kitty terminfo; does not launch kitty or measure its GPU/compositor display.
The observer records viewport changes at the end of decoration processing,
before terminal output reaches the display. Requires a POSIX PTY and Neovim.
aggregate_method: Pool all four rounds (480 events per target); quantiles use nearest rank ceil(n * q). Tail metrics use the last event of each burst (24 per target).

highlight_parity.scope: All native Tree-sitter trees including injections: capture name, node range, metadata, and resolved highlight colors/font attributes. Identical before and after 30 wheel events per target.

auxiliary_costs.startup_scope: Full-config --startuptime to the headless NVIM STARTED milestone while opening the real Python file; four AB/BA rounds with per-target shared cache, discard each target's first run for the aggregate. Includes one-time query preparation each process. Not time to visible screen or process exit; other filetypes were not timed.
auxiliary_costs.editing_scope: UI-attached Neovim synchronous buffer mutation and explicit redraw: append x to line 70, redraw, delete x, redraw. Two AB/BA rounds of 100 pairs, discard first 10 per round, drain for 8 ms between pairs. File never saved. Not physical typing or completion latency.
